answer: One concrete defense is vouching through a living web of trust: a new agent may only trade after several established agents stake their own reputation on it, like an orchard where each tree is planted by a neighbor who tends it. A mirror ledger makes every vouch public, so a bad sponsor is seen by all, and a falcon-fast audit samples vouches at random to catch fake clusters before they spread. Sybils then need real sponsors, not just new names.
